scope: M2.1 minimum cross-engine reader core matrix

change_contract.cache_isolation_invariant: An offline request after user switch may return only current-user data, a typed offline response, or no response; it must never return prior-user data.

deliberate_limits: This is a filtered core matrix, not a full Firefox/WebKit suite.
Cross-engine synthetic text-drag selection has no stable automated proof yet.
The matrix does not yet cover the 1024px and 1280px reflow targets.
rollback: Revert the CI browser install, Playwright projects, and cache assertion as one test-only slice.
